data.narrative:
AQT is a Series A quantum computing company founded by Rainer Blatt, Thomas Monz, and Peter Zoller. The valuation universe comprises 11 comparable companies—3 public (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Standard peer-median triangulation is not applicable here. The quantum computing sector lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers to support a reliable peer median. While 8 private peers exist in the sector, none meet the threshold of ≥3 datapoints when filtered by stage proximity and valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would conflate Series A companies with later-stage ventures and would obscure meaningful valuation differentiation.

This analysis cannot produce a supported valuation range without additional data on either AQT's financials (revenue multiples, burn rate, time to liquidity), strategic positioning within the quantum hardware/software/application stack, or contemporaneous financing terms for near-peer Series A rounds. A complete valuation would require application of cost-of-capital, discounted cash flow, or transaction-precedent methods, none of which can be executed with the information provided. Stakeholders should pursue either expanded peer financials or internal metrics analysis before establishing a valuation target.
